sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Closest to Microcerotermes parvulus but smaller in size: head length including mandibles 1.55—1.66, head width 0.65—0.68, mandible length 0.55—0.61 mm. Type locality Agouagon, Dahomey (present-day Benin), the type specimens in the Paris and Stockholm museums.

note: Adapted from the original description by Sjöstedt (1925), original in German; it is a brief diagnostic description of the soldier (vorläufige Mitteilung) and describes the soldier only.
